name: xrpl-command-center
description: Cross-platform real-time XRP Ledger Command Center, visual telemetry engine, token/validator explorer, and self-hosted rippled/Clio node operations console.
author: XRPL Command Center Contributors

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON -c cyan,green "vite --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && node scripts/stage-sidecar.mjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
